component.name: Musette
component.summary: YouTube Music player for Linux phones

description.p: Musette is an unofficial YouTube Music client built on SimpMusic. Browse your library, search for music or queue tracks in a native GNOME interface for FuriOS.

ul.li: Home feed, search with suggestions, albums, artists and playlists
Your library and the playlists of your YouTube account
Background playback with controls on the lock screen
Likes that sync to YouTube when you are signed in

description.p: Musette is not affiliated with SimpMusic or Google.
First release: home feed, search, albums, artists, playlists, your library, a queue, background playback, lock screen controls and YouTube likes.
